type Arg<F> = F extends (value: infer U) => void ? U : never;
const a: Arg<(value?: string) => void> = undefined;
const b: Arg<(value?: number) => void> = undefined;
const c: Arg<(value: string | undefined) => void> = undefined;
function defaulted(value = 'initialized') {}
const d: Arg<typeof defaulted> = undefined;
const e: Arg<(...values: [value?: number]) => void> = undefined;
type OptionalTarget<F> = F extends (value?: infer U) => void ? U : 'no';
const f: OptionalTarget<(value: string) => void> = 'no';
type FirstAndRest<F> = F extends (value: infer U, ...tail: infer R) => void ? [U, R] : never;
const g: FirstAndRest<(...items: string[]) => void> = ['first', ['next']];
const h: FirstAndRest<(value: string, later?: number) => void> = ['first', []];
type ParametersOf<F> = F extends (...args: infer T) => void ? T : never;
const i: ParametersOf<(...values: boolean[]) => void> = [true, false];
console.log(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i);
